reviews.content: This book is amazing. It teaches skills to de-escalate and mitigate miscommunication, misunderstandings and to give voice to our sweet peas who can't figure out how to express themselves. It's amazing.
reviews.title: Teaches communication skills to de-escalate

reviews.content: The summary on ParentsDigest. com showed this book to be as succinct, insightful and easy to follow as his 'Happiest Baby on the Block'. I would refer it to friend and I will look for more good advice from this author.
reviews.title: More Really Good Advice from Harvey Karp, MD

reviews.content: As with both his books (Happiest Baby and Happiest Toddler), the text seemed very repetitive. Plus the techniques he teaches are best understood through observation. Check the dvd out from your local library. I have used his techniques on babies and toddlers and give him 5 stars for coming up with some very logical and useful tools.
reviews.title: Watch the DVD
